items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where, where did they make these records, Mr. Robert?

ctx.x: Back there, they were living back there. But the Shields did live on 3rd street. 3rd street. 3rd street is right. That's where they lived. Mm-hmm. On 3rd street.
Where, where did they make these records, Mr. Robert?
